name: Cao Cao's Ambition--A Harem of MILFs
detailed_description:
◆Story

In times of chaos, heroes are born. During the waning years of the Eastern Han, as imperial power crumbled and the people suffered, countless warlords rose in the struggle to unify the land.
I, Cao, was no exception—though my ambition differed.
What I sought to conquer was not only the land beneath their feet... but also the women who stood behind them.

But such a grand ambition demands long-term planning. How should I open the curtains on this journey? How can I reach its final act?
Will this burning desire consume my friendships and loyalty? If old comrades become bitter enemies, how will I face them?
And those married women, taken far from their homes—how will I win their true hearts and make them willingly submit to me?

With challenges pressing in from all sides, I must remain ever more thoughtful and farsighted.
This ambition, this desire... may seem improper to others, but to me, it is no trivial matter.
With loyal allies like Fengxiao and Yuanrang by my side, my grand vision is far from impossible.

This brilliant game of chess must not, under any circumstances, fall into disarray.

◆Gameplay

The player takes on the role of Cao Cao, striving to strengthen the nation, build military might, and enhance personal capabilities amidst the chaos of war—all in pursuit of unifying the land.

Each month, players can perform four key actions.

At the start of the month, you’ll issue directives that affect national statistics—such as Conscription, Research, Domestic Affairs, Inspection, and Taxation.
You can also engage in Diplomacy to trade with other factions, or use the Military command to monitor the status of various regions and launch attacks on enemies.

After court is dismissed, you can further develop yourself and your state by visiting the Study, Barracks, or Training Grounds.
You can also head to the Harem to visit the wives you’ve acquired, and choose the “H” option to conquer them using your special training techniques.

Every choice you make will influence the nation's stats—bringing Cao Cao closer to, or further from, his ultimate ambition.

◆Game Features

◇ 18 fully animated HCGs, including 11 base H scenes and 7 special training H scenes, with over 350 variations.
◇ 5 normal CG illustrations and several bonus artworks, with over 80 variations.
◇ Strategic management and simulation gameplay.
◇ 7 trainable wives, 4 secondary wives, and 4 companions—15 female characters in total.
◇ Four different game endings.

short_description: In the waning years of the Eastern Han, the land was torn apart by warlords, each harboring grand ambitions of unifying the realm. Some claimed it was for the people, for the common good, or for power... As for me, Cao — I too have my own grand desire. And that is—to claim all the married women under heaven as mine!
